=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:132-160 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The probe step exports ALL_SECRETS_JSON containing all repository secrets, and each Claude probe subprocess inherits it.
  WHY: Every probe can read all pool-account tokens and GH_PAT, defeating per-account credential isolation.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:184-191, 243-248, 267-273, 331-341 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The auto-mode worker can modify the writable pool checkout's `pool/scripts/claude_pool.py`, which the later redaction step executes with live secrets in its environment.
  WHY: A modified helper can bypass transcript redaction or expose credentials before the transcript artifact is uploaded.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:331-350 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Transcript upload runs under `if: always()` without being gated on successful redaction.
  WHY: If redaction fails, the upload can publish the remaining unredacted transcript files as an artifact.
- scripts/claude_pool.py:696-710 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `redact_text` does not include plain base64(secret) in its redaction candidates.
  WHY: A worker can emit a base64-encoded token that survives redaction and remains in the uploaded transcript; reviewers disagree on severity, with the highest assessment being critical.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:61-63, 145-159 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The select job has a 10-minute timeout while account probes run sequentially with up to 180 seconds each and the account count is not capped.
  WHY: Four probes reaching their timeout consume 12 minutes before selection completes, exceeding the job limit; reviewers disagree on severity, with the highest assessment being high.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:250 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The MCP configuration writes a literal `${CLAUDE_POOL_MCP_TOKEN}` into the Authorization header and relies on undocumented environment-variable expansion.
  WHY: If Claude Code does not expand the placeholder, GitHub MCP authentication fails; z-ai_glm-5_2 calls this a false positive, citing documented expansion and a successful phase 1 smoke run.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:243-248 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The comment claims shell redirects to `.claude/**` are denied, but the deny list covers Edit, Write, and NotebookEdit only, not Bash.
  WHY: An auto-mode Bash command can write to the target checkout's `.claude/**`, contrary to the protection the comment describes; reviewers disagree on severity, with the highest assessment being high.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:337-341 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The redaction step uses `set -uo pipefail` without `set -e`.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree about whether this can hide a redaction failure: some say a failed final command still determines the step outcome, while others say missing `set -e` can leave failures unsurfaced; the highest severity assigned is high.
- .github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml:153-156 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The probe step uses `set -uo pipefail` without `set -e`, and only explicitly checks the `accounts` invocation.
  WHY: The reviewer says failures in subsequent probe processing may produce a crashed outcome rather than a structured verdict.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:42, 97 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The inventory has no entries for `.github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml` or `scripts/claude_pool.py`.
  WHY: The CI parity check compares tracked workflow and script paths against these sections and reports both files missing, causing the check to fail.
- README.md:1548-1550 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The README lists `/implement-plan-claude … — resume.` as a worker command without stating that stage items are currently refused.
  WHY: The current implementation raises `PoolError` for stage items because `claude_issue_route.parse_stage_text` is not yet available.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The repository parity gate inventories every `.github/workflows/*.yml` path and tracked `scripts/` path in `docs/INVENTORY.md`; the new worker workflow and script must be listed there.
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md, Workflows section and Scripts section
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The PR adds `.github/workflows/claude-pool-worker.yml` and `scripts/claude_pool.py`, but no inventory hunk or entries for either path are present; the parity test reports both paths missing.
- requirement: The phase 1 checklist must enumerate all subcommands implemented by `scripts/claude_pool.py`, including `config` and `redact`.
  expected_change_site: docs/implement-plan/claude-actions-worker-pool.md, phase 1 checklist at line 17
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The checklist names only `accounts`, `normalize`, `probe-parse`, `choose`, `prompt`, `classify`, and `run-name`; `scripts/claude_pool.py` implements `config` and `redact` as well.
- requirement: The README Claude worker pool section should describe which item types the phase 1 worker can run and clarify that stage execution is currently refused until phase 3.
  expected_change_site: README.md, Claude worker pool section, step 2 work description
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The README lists `/implement-plan-claude … — resume.` without the stage limitation; `scripts/claude_pool.py` raises `PoolError` for stage items while `claude_issue_route.parse_stage_text` is absent.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: The reviewer notes this is benign because the redaction command is the final command and its exit code still determines the step outcome.
